name: bricks-ctor-agent-skills
description: Official CTOR plugins from the BRICKS team — document import workflows, AI feature guidance, 3D content pipelines, and reusable app templates.

plugins.name: document-essentials
plugins.description: Parse PDF, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files and import their content into your app — Data entries, properties, slideshows, and media assets.

plugins.name: ai-toolkit
plugins.description: Choose the right AI generator and model for each device, then wire voice, RAG, and generative-media features with proven patterns.

plugins.name: scene3d-studio
plugins.description: Model in Blender, export glTF, compose scenes in the Scene3D brick, script interactions, and ship 3D demos or mini-games to devices.

plugins.name: app-templates
plugins.description: Turn an existing app into a reusable prompt template — a short requirement list that captures its design, state, and data flow so you can rebuild or remix it.
